{{Top|leg}}
The '''propagandist''' played a crucial role in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by shaping public perception and influencing opinion during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While many worked with truth—exposing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] atrocities, corruption, and brutality—others manipulated facts or even crafted falsehoods to serve the greater cause. They understood that truth was often a matter of perspective and used this insight to inspire courage, sway the undecided, and demoralize Imperial supporters.<ref name="Desperate Allies">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref>

They leaked carefully chosen facts, spread rumors, and sometimes created outright fabrications to shift sentiment in the Alliance's favor. Operating through informal networks and tailoring their rhetoric to specific audiences, propagandists stirred outrage, inspired resistance, and fueled the spread of hope across oppressed worlds. Whether gathering secrets or planting lies, they treated information as both a weapon and a shield, fighting an invisible but vital war alongside the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] on the front lines.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Propagandist was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
